question: Does the amended engine's asserted set get better, or only larger, as coverage rises to its ceiling?
quantity: precision = covered_world_edges / final_asserted_edges_count, per cell of the paired capacity harness
basis: The final asserted structure filtered to the world's vocabulary and excluding non-vocabulary markers, exactly the set the harness scores for coverage. This is NOT the Layer-1 selection precision whose ceiling is 0.3438 in docs/GATE13-CAUSAL-ACCOUNT.md — different quantity, different basis, not comparable.
finding: Precision is flat. Every arm on a later build sits between 0.4155 and 0.4746 (spread 0.0591), and raising the cap from 20 to 1,000 moves recall from 0.4821-0.7500 to 1.0000 without moving precision: the amended engine's median is 0.4576 at cap 20 and 0.4571 at cap 1,000, against 0.4602 at e6d1bcc/cap 20. The amendment changes which structures are asserted and how many, not how often an asserted edge is a world edge.
limits: Five diagnostic seeds, 2-tag compositional world, one world family; no confirmatory seed. Precision here is measured on the final asserted set, so it says nothing about the earlier Layer-1 selection stage or about precision under a different allocation rule.
